verdict.line: You concede the laning phase to Mordekaiser's melee all-ins, but Urgot pulls ahead once Black Cleaver stacks and Sterak's Gage land, backing a 57.4% head-to-head win rate over 136 games.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser holds the raw lane and solo-kill edge because he out-trades you in melee range and threatens a forced 1v1 with R (Realm of Death), but Urgot's kit is built to poke from outside that range and out-scale him with items. That structural mismatch between early lane shape and late-game power is why Urgot still wins 57.4% of recorded games despite the matchup being labeled defensive.

theirWindow.when: His E (Death's Grasp) up, passive stacked
theirWindow.what: Back off immediately. E pulls you in from 700 range and chains into Q (8/7/6/5/4s cd); his passive (Darkness Rise) triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells and buffs his damage and move speed once it's up.

yourWindow.what: Close with E (Disdain, 475 range) to trample in and stop him, then unload Q and autos. Without his W shield he has nothing to offset the trade, so this is when you force damage.

powerCurve.note: Melee Q trades outpace your early poke
E pull + Q all-in window is live

start.why: Most-picked start (81.1% pick, 61% WR over 146 games) — the extra sustain matters because you're absorbing Q and auto trades while waiting to poke back at range.

boots.why: Highest-pick boots (64.5% pick, 55.9% WR over 111 games); the magic resist directly blunts his Q/E magic damage and the tenacity shortens any CC chain after an E pull.

core.why: Armor shred turns your Q and auto trades lethal once stacked — this is the item that flips the matchup from 'even' to 'yours' around levels 9-13.
Health and tenacity let you survive his all-in windows and keep trading instead of losing extended fights.
Top build path (18.6% pick, 77.3% WR over 22 games) — stacking resistances lets you tank his Q/E magic damage while you out-trade him in melee range.

situational.when: he's hitting hard enough with Q/E magic damage that you need more flat magic resist plus a burst shield
his W (Indestructible) shield is consistently blunting your damage in fights
you need to cut the healing he gets from consuming his W shield

runes.keystoneWhy: Your Q and auto-attacks land from range before he closes, so you can stack PTA's three hits and punish the trade the moment he enters melee — important since you're playing from a lane deficit and need every trade to count.

summoners.why: Highest-performing combo (58.7% WR, 84.7% pick). Ignite's grievous wounds cuts the healing he gets from consuming his W shield, and Flash lets you dodge his E (Death's Grasp) pull or extend your own E engage.

playing.title: Hold max range
playing.detail: Stay at Q's 800 range and auto range rather than trading in melee. His passive (Darkness Rise) needs 3 landed attacks or spells on champions or monsters to trigger, so staying out of range denies it.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s, 700 range) pulls you in and chains into his Q. If it's up, don't hover at the edge of lane.

playing.title: Punish W downtime
playing.detail: Close with E (Disdain, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cd, 475 range) when his W (Indestructible, 12/11/10/9/8s cd) is on cooldown — he has no shield to offset the trade.

playing.title: Respect level 6 onward
playing.detail: Once he has R (Realm of Death, 100/85/70/70/70s cd, 650 range) he can drag you into an isolated fight. Don't overextend near that range when you're low.

playing.title: Zone with Q, not melee
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cd, 800 range) slows and chips wave state without exposing you to his melee combo.

playing.title: Play for farm, not kills
playing.detail: Your win rate climbs once Black Cleaver and Sterak's Gage complete. Take short trades and even CS until then rather than forcing all-ins.

playing.title: Finish fights with E into W
playing.detail: Once items are online, engage with E (Disdain) to stop and displace him, then unload W (Purge, cooldown drops to 0s at rank 5), which prioritizes him and triggers Echoing Flames.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance to deactivate Mordekaiser’s (P). Close in with [E] when his (W) is on cooldown.
